_comment: Single source of truth for the static/FPGA KAT test generator (gen_static_test.py). Each shape corresponds to one of the distinct crypto API calling conventions found across the PQC families in this repo (see harness/gen/main_*.c). Adding a family means adding a shape renderer (if new) in gen_static_test.py plus variant entries here.

kem_derand.description: keypair_derand(pk,sk,coins), enc_derand(ct,ss,pk,coins), dec(ss,ct,sk). Used by ML-KEM.

ds_derand_ctx.description: keypair(pk,sk,seed), sign(sm,&smlen,m,mlen,ctx,ctxlen,sk,rnd), open(m,&mlen,sm,smlen,ctx,ctxlen,pk). Used by ML-DSA.

ds_derand_rnd.description: keypair(pk,sk,rnd), sign(sm,&smlen,m,mlen,sk,rnd), open(m,&mlen,sm,smlen,pk). Used by SLH-DSA (FIPS 205 sets) and the legacy Haraka SPHINCS+ families.

ds_derand_seed.description: keypair(pk,sk,seed), sign(sm,&smlen,m,mlen,sk) [no rnd -- signing is fully deterministic], open(m,&mlen,sm,smlen,pk). Used by XMSS/LMS/HSS, each pinned to one parameter set via a dedicated src_dir (see algorithms/signatures/stateful/{XMSS,LMS,HSS}/<VARIANT>/) -- their real APIs are runtime-parametrized (see algorithms/signatures/stateful/README.md), unlike every other DS family here.

ds_derand_rnd_nonce.description: keypair(pk,sk,rnd), sign(sm,&smlen,m,mlen,sk,nonce,rnd), open(m,&mlen,sm,smlen,pk). Used by Falcon (extra nonce vs ds_derand_rnd) and the experimental c-fn-dsa FN-DSA variants.

ds_drbg_cross.description: No derand API. Reseed CROSS's own csprng_initialize(&platform_csprng_state, seed, 48, CSPRNG_DOMAIN_SEP_CONST) then keypair(pk,sk)/sign(sm,&smlen,m,mlen,sk)/open(m,&mlen,sm,smlen,pk). keypair is always called (even with RUN_KEYGEN=0) to keep the CSPRNG stream position correct for sign.

ds_drbg_less.description: No derand API. Reseed LESS's own initialize_csprng(&platform_csprng_state, seed, 48) then keypair/sign/open, same signatures as ds_drbg_cross. keypair always called for the same CSPRNG-advance reason.

ds_drbg_hawk.description: No derand API. Reseed via randombytes_init(seed, NULL, 256), skip the mlen bytes the generator drew for the message, then keypair/sign/open. Unlike CROSS/LESS, keypair is only called when RUN_KEYGEN=1 -- matches harness/gen/main_hawk.c exactly, including its RUN_KEYGEN=0 CSPRNG-desync caveat (see tools/README.md). Shared verbatim by HAWK, FAEST, UOV, MAYO, QRUOV, SNOVA, and SDitH (main_faest.c/main_uov.c/main_mayo.c/main_qruov.c/main_snova.c/main_sdith.c are the same shape: FAEST's rand_bytes(), pqov's randombytes(), MAYO-C's randombytes(), QR-UOV's randombytes(), SNOVA's randombytes(), and SDitH's randombytes() all forward straight to the reseeded NIST DRBG, no internal CSPRNG object of their own; main_mayo.c differs only in using size_t instead of unsigned long long for smlen/mlen, matching MAYO's own api.h; main_sdith.c uses unsigned long long like main_hawk.c, matching SDitH's own api.h in both Hypercube_Variant and Threshold_Variant).

ds_drbg_nist.description: Same as ds_drbg_hawk (no derand API; reseed via randombytes_init(seed, NULL, 256); keypair(pk,sk)/sign(sm,&smlen,m,mlen,sk)/open(m,&mlen,sm,smlen,pk); unsigned long long smlen/mlen) except that nothing is skipped after the reseed: the .rsp follows the official NIST PQCgenKAT_sign procedure (the message is drawn from the entropy-seeded DRBG BEFORE reseeding with `seed`), so keygen runs immediately after randombytes_init(seed) and seed -> pk/sk matches the submitter's official KAT files. Used by MQOM3 (harness/gen/main_mqom.c).

kem_prng_reseed.description: No explicit seed params. Reseed via prng_init(seed,NULL,48,0) then keypair(pk,sk)/enc(ct,ss,pk)/dec(ss,ct,sk). Used by HQC-2025. Same RUN_KEYGEN=0 desync caveat as ds_drbg_hawk.

aead_direct.description: No keygen, no derand/coins: crypto_aead_encrypt(c,&clen,m,mlen,ad,adlen,NULL,npub,k), crypto_aead_decrypt(m,&mlen,NULL,c,clen,ad,adlen,npub,k). Key/nonce/ad/plaintext are all fixed-length per variant and taken directly from the .rsp -- deterministic by construction, no RNG replay needed. Used by ASCON's AEAD variants (ascon128v12, ascon128av12, ascon80pqv12). RUN_ENCAPS/RUN_DECAPS gate encrypt/decrypt (no keygen flag).

hash_direct.description: Single call, no key/nonce/AD, no RUN_* flag: crypto_hash(out,in,inlen). Used by ASCON's hash/XOF variants (asconhashv12, asconhashav12, asconxofv12, asconxofav12).

ds_drbg_official.description: Like ds_drbg_nist (official NIST PQCgenKAT_sign flow: message drawn from the entropy-seeded DRBG BEFORE reseeding with `seed`; keygen runs right after randombytes_init(seed)) but the message length is NOT constant: the official Round-3 KATs use mlen = 33*(count+1). mlen and the messages are therefore emitted per record (TVEC_MLEN[], TVEC_IN_M_SIGN_LEN[]) and --kat-num > 1 works. Optional per-variant registry flags: "size_t_api": true -> smlen/mlen1 are size_t (MAYO's api.h; unsigned long long is an error with gcc >= 14); "static_gcc_flags": informational extra flags the static folder needs with plain gcc (e.g. -lm, -I.), printed by the generator. Used by the Round-3 families MAYO-R3, UOV-R3, SNOVA-R3, QRUOV-R3, SDITH-R3, SQISIGN-R3 (harness/gen/main_*_r3.c). MQOM (constant mlen) keeps ds_drbg_nist.
